title: cleome brachycarpa f. diversifolia
intro: Cleome brachycarpa f. diversifolia, commonly known as Spiny Spiderflower, is a flowering plant species in the Cleomaceae family. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include aiding in the relief of coughs and colds, as well as exhibiting anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties, contributing to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Cleome brachycarpa f. diversifolia include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, although more specific information about these constituents may be limited.
